title: Prospection
description:
We are looking for a reliable and professional Virtual Assistant / B2B Caller to conduct a straightforward data-gathering campaign.



Your sole mission is to call medium to large Canadian companies (100 to 500+ employees) to identify which provider they currently use for their Group Benefits / Pension Plan (RPDB, RRSP). There is absolutely NO SELLING involved. This is a pure administrative and market research task.



Responsibilities:

Call a provided list of Canadian companies (100+ employees).



Ask a quick, structured question to find out who their current provider is for their Group Benefits / Pension Plan.



Accurately log the provider names into a provided Google Sheet.



Performance Requirement: You must successfully qualify and deliver data for a minimum of 100 new companies per week.



Responsibilities & Data to Collect:

For every company called, you will be required to update a Google Sheet with the following information:



Company Name



Current Pension Plan / Group Benefits Provider (e.g., Manulife, Sun Life, Canada Life, etc.)



Region / Province (Identify if the company/branch is located in Quebec, Ontario, or another Canadian province)



Performance Requirement:

You must successfully qualify and deliver data for a minimum of 100 new companies per week.

title: Admin Team Lead / Virtual Operations Lead
description:
About Us:

Daily Frequency Rentals is a growing car rental company based in Cleveland, Ohio. We are building a strong operations team focused on customer service, accountability, speed, and organization. We already have a virtual admin team in place, and we are now hiring an Admin Team Lead / Virtual Operations Lead to help oversee the team, solve problems, improve communication, and help us scale.



This is not just a customer service role.



We are looking for someone who can take ownership, lead other VAs, keep the team organized, handle escalations, follow through, and help management make sure the admin side of the business runs smoothly every day.



Position Summary:

The Admin Team Lead / Virtual Operations Lead will be responsible for helping manage Daily Frequency Rentals’ virtual admin team and supporting daily operations. This person will oversee current VAs, make sure tasks are completed correctly and on time, help solve issues inside the team, assist with customer escalations, improve systems and communication, and serve as a reliable point of contact between the admin team and management.



This role is ideal for someone who is highly organized, calm under pressure, detail-oriented, confident in leading people, and strong in customer communication.



Key Responsibilities:

1) Oversee the Virtual Admin Team

Help manage and support current VAs on a daily basis

Make sure assigned tasks are completed correctly and on time

Monitor team performance, follow-up, responsiveness, and accountability

Answer team questions and help solve day-to-day issues before they reach management

Identify mistakes, recurring issues, or gaps in execution and help correct them

Keep the admin team organized, aligned, and moving efficiently

Help train new VAs and reinforce current processes/SOPs

Report performance concerns, wins, and team issues to management

2) Customer Support Oversight & Escalations

Step in on difficult customer situations when needed

Handle escalated customer concerns in a calm, professional, solution-oriented way

Help resolve issues involving bookings, extensions, payments, balances, vehicle concerns, and general customer service problems

Escalate major issues to management when necessary with clear notes and context

Make sure customer communication remains professional, consistent, and aligned with company policy

3) Admin Operations Support

Help oversee bookings, extensions, payment reminders, collections follow-up, account notes, and customer communication

Review admin work for accuracy and completeness

Ensure customer accounts, internal notes, and communication logs are updated properly

Help maintain organization in CRM/software, spreadsheets, and internal task systems

Assist with daily admin workflow so nothing falls through the cracks

Help management identify where bottlenecks are happening and how to improve them

4) Process Improvement / Scaling Support

Look for ways to improve admin workflows, communication, task management, and follow-up

Help organize and improve SOP execution

Suggest process improvements that make the company more efficient and scalable

Help build structure, accountability, and consistency across the admin team

Support management in creating a more reliable day-to-day operations system

5) Communication & Leadership

Serve as a reliable bridge between management and the virtual admin team

Communicate clearly with the team regarding expectations, priorities, and updates

Bring problems forward with solutions, not just questions

Help create a positive, accountable, team-first environment

Maintain professionalism, confidentiality, and strong judgment in all communication

What Success Looks Like in This Role



We are looking for someone who can help us create a stronger, more dependable admin team. Success in this role means:

The VA team is more organized and accountable

Customer issues are handled faster and more professionally

Fewer problems need to be escalated to ownership

Tasks are followed through without constant reminders

Team communication improves

SOPs are actually being followed

Admin operations become smoother and easier to scale

Required Qualifications

Previous experience leading or supervising a remote team, admin team, customer support team, or operations team

Strong English communication skills, both written and verbal

Strong customer service and conflict-resolution skills

High attention to detail and strong follow-through

Strong organizational and time-management skills

Able to manage multiple moving parts without losing track

Comfortable giving direction, answering team questions, and holding others accountable

Calm under pressure and professional when handling difficult customers

Able to work independently and make sound decisions

Reliable internet connection and reliable work setup

Available to work during required U.S. business hours

Preferred Qualifications



These are a plus, but not required:

Experience in operations, property management, logistics, transportation, fleet, reservations, or car rental

Experience managing inboxes, customer support systems, CRMs, or admin workflows

Experience with process documentation / SOPs

Experience with collections follow-up, payment reminders, or account coordination

Experience using Google Sheets, Google Docs, and task/project management tools

Experience reviewing team performance and helping improve execution





The ideal person for this role is:

organized

proactive

reliable

a strong communicator

able to lead others respectfully

comfortable making decisions

good at solving problems

able to stay calm when customers or team members create pressure

not someone who waits to be told every next step



Preferred schedule:

40 hours per week

Must be available during Daily Frequency Rentals business hours or have strong overlap with 8:00 AM – 8:00 PM Eastern Time Monday–Friday, and Saturday/Sunday availability is a plus

Some flexibility preferred for urgent issues, escalations, or team support when needed





Why Join Us:

Long-term opportunity with a growing U.S. company

Leadership role with room to grow

Work directly with ownership and help shape operations

Stable, structured role with real responsibility

Opportunity to help build systems, improve a team, and make a meaningful impact

Application Instructions





To apply, please
 us the following at: 

Your resume

A short video introduction (2–3 minutes) answering:

Why are you a good fit for this role?

What experience do you have leading a team?

How do you handle difficult customers or team problems?

A short written answer to this question:

If two VAs are confused about a process, a customer is upset, and management is busy, how would you handle the situation?

title: International Business Development Agent — Poland / CEE Market Entry Support
description:
International B2B Sales Agent / Business Development Representative



Client Acquisition for Warehouse, Fulfillment & Operational Facility in Poland



We are looking for an experienced International B2B Sales Agent / Business Development Representative to help us acquire a foreign client or business partner for our operational facility near Warsaw, Poland.



This is not a standard Virtual Assistant role.



We are not looking for someone who only sends
s, fills in spreadsheets, or passes us empty leads. We need someone who can actively contact companies, make phone calls, speak with decision-makers, ask the right questions, understand business needs, and deliver qualified opportunities for advanced business discussions.



?



About the Project



We have an operational facility in Marki, near Warsaw, Poland, which can be used as:



* warehouse space,

* fulfillment point,

* packing / labeling area,

* light assembly or simple production space,

* local operational base,

* distribution support hub for Poland and Central/Eastern Europe,

* local partner location for a foreign company entering the Polish / EU market.



The facility includes:



* approx. 500 m² hall space with staff / social area,

* approx. 300 m² covered warehouse shelters,

* approx. 2,500 m² yard / land area,

* paved and monitored area,

* maneuvering yard,

* possibility to adapt the cooperation model to the client’s needs,

* possibility to organize staff and operational support.



We are looking for foreign companies that may need a flexible local partner in Poland / CEE instead of immediately setting up their own company, warehouse, team, and local structure.



?



Target Companies



We are especially interested in companies that:



* do not yet have a strong operational structure in Poland or the EU,

* want to enter Poland, Central/Eastern Europe, or the EU market,

* have logistics, customs, warehousing, fulfillment, or distribution problems,

* need a smaller and more flexible alternative to large 3PL providers,

* sell premium, specialized, technical, medical, cosmetic, industrial, or B2B products,

* may benefit from local warehousing, fulfillment, labeling, packing, distribution support, operational coordination, or market entry support.



Interesting markets include:



* United Kingdom,

* USA,

* Canada,

* Australia,

* Singapore,

* UAE,

* India,

* Asia,

* other non-Polish / non-EU international markets.



We do not want to focus only on one country. We are looking for companies for which Poland can solve a real supply chain, distribution, European market entry, or warehousing problem.



?



What We Already Have



You will not start from zero.



We already have:



* initial database of potential companies,

* target industries and markets,

* company
 address,

* Apollo account for contact verification,

* CloudTalk / calling tool,

* outreach tracker,

* first tested outreach messages,

* call script framework,

* clear business objective.



We need someone who can take this process and turn it into real business conversations.



?



Your Main Responsibility



Your task is to actively acquire a real business opportunity.



You will be expected to:



* contact companies by phone,
, and LinkedIn,

* identify the right decision-makers,

* speak with people responsible for logistics, operations, distribution, expansion, procurement, or partnerships,

* understand the company’s current situation,

* ask about operational problems, market entry plans, volume, budget level, and decision process,

* qualify whether the company is a real fit,

* prepare a complete lead profile before handing it over to us.



We do not want “empty leads” such as only a company name or generic
 address.



A qualified opportunity should include:



* company name and website,

* country and industry,

* contact person and position,

* confirmation that the person is relevant,

* current activity in Europe / Poland / CEE,

* current logistics, warehouse, distributor, 3PL, or partner setup,

* operational problem or business need,

* expected support needed,

* possible volume or scale,

* possible timeline,

* budget level or cost expectations if discussed,

* decision-maker information,

* recommendation for next step.



Only after this information is collected can our team prepare a serious business proposal.



?



Requirements



We are looking for someone with real experience in:



* B2B sales,

* cold calling,

* international outreach,

* appointment setting,

* business development,

* lead qualification,

* speaking with decision-makers,

* working toward a concrete business result.



You must be comfortable making business phone calls in English.



Experience in logistics, warehousing, fulfillment, distribution, export/import, e-commerce, manufacturing, medical devices, industrial products, or market entry will be a strong advantage.



?



Compensation



This role is based on a low base rate + high success fee model.



Trial Period



* Trial period: 7–10 days

* Trial rate: 3 USD/hour

* Goal: verify your ability to make calls, qualify prospects, collect useful business information, and report clearly.



Success Fee



We are ready to pay a strong success fee for real results.



Success fee starts from 2,000 USD and may be higher, depending on:



* the type of client,

* the value of the cooperation,

* whether the client starts with a small pilot or larger operation,

* whether the client uses part of the facility or the full location,

* expected monthly cooperation value,

* long-term potential of the relationship.



The success fee is paid for a real business result — a company genuinely acquired through your work that enters into actual cooperation with us.



This is a strong opportunity for someone who trusts their B2B sales skills and wants to earn mainly from results, not only from hours.



?



Long-Term Opportunity



If the acquired company d
 to cooperate with us, this does not have to be the end of your role.



You may continue as our:



* international communication coordinator,

* account manager,

* business development representative,

* foreign partner communication representative.



Your role could include maintaining communication with the foreign partner and supporting the ongoing cooperation.



?



Important



We have limited time to secure a foreign partner for this location.



If we do not find the right foreign company, the facility may be rented to a local Polish business. In that case, this international sales role may no longer be needed in the same scope.



We need someone who can take this seriously, act quickly, and focus on real client acquisition.



?

Please answer the questions below in your application:



1. What is your experience in B2B sales and cold calling?

2. Have you acquired foreign clients by phone before?

3. What industries have you worked with?

 to a UK or US company that may need a flexible operational base in Poland.

Generic applications without answers to these questions will not be considered.



We are looking for someone who can say:



“Give me the database, tools, and clear goal, and I will call, find the right people, qualify the opportunity, collect the information, and move the company toward serious business conversations.”



If this describes you, we would like to hear from you.

title: Date site Weekly Event Outreach Assistant
description:
GBU Weekly Event Outreach Assistant – Briefing



Hi! Before we start, I first want to check if you’re comfortable with this type of work.



This role involves promoting a gay men’s social event on Sniffies, a gay dating/social platform. You’ll chat with adult users, invite suitable men to a weekly event group, and answer basic questions using the message templates I provide. Nothing explicit is required, but because of the platform, please let me know if you’re comfortable with this.



Your Role



Each week you’ll receive:



* Event city

* Date & hours

* Event description

* Updated message templates



Your tasks:



* Browse profiles and prioritize attractive, friendly, social men (generally under 40).

* Start conversations naturally.

* Invite interested users to the event group.

* Answer questions using the provided information.

* Once the group is full, direct people to the GBU website to submit an application.



Time Required



Usually around 3 hours/week (about 30 minutes on Monday, Tuesday and Wednesday, then finish on Thursday). Some weeks require less if the group is nearly full already.



Example Messages



Invite:

“Hey! Wanna come this Friday? GBU is hosting a huge event. Check my profile and accept the invite I sent to your groups ????”



What is GBU?

“GBU is an underground, curated social event for hundreds of guys. It’s not a circuit party. Great music, social atmosphere and an attractive crowd.”



Interested?

“Great! Just submit an application through the GBU website and we’ll send you all the event details.”



Group Full:

“The Sniffies group filled up fast, but we’re still accepting applications through the GBU website.”



After sending an invite:

“Accept the invite I just sent to your groups. All the event details are there ????”



Goal



The goal is to fill the weekly event group with quality attendees while keeping conversations friendly and professional. I update all event details and message templates every week, so you simply use the latest information I send.



Proof of Work



Please send screenshots showing:



* Conversations and invitations sent.

* The event group reaching its target.

* If the group is full, screenshots showing users redirected to the website.



If this sounds good and you’re comfortable promoting events on a gay dating platform, I’d be happy to work together!

The studio runs across two sides: graphic design (branding, logos, web, cover art, merch) and wedding / event stationery (menus, signage, place cards, full suites, Canva sites etc.), so you'd be touching a real mix of work. Take a look at what I do at 
 
 on Instagram] for a general feel. That's just a taster, as I work with lots of clients across music, hospitality, retail, beauty and more.



WHAT YOU'D ACTUALLY BE DOING



You'd be working across both sides of the studio, so this is a real mix of digital and print, branding and stationery.



~ Taking a design (say a poster) and adapting it into multiple assets: social square, story 9:16, banner, web sizes. Done properly, with real attention to layout and hierarchy at each ratio, not just squashing it to fit.

~ File prep for print, mostly on the stationery side: menus, signage, place cards, full suites. Setting up files correctly for print (bleed, crop marks, CMYK, correct dimensions) and getting them press-ready.

~ Building and styling Canva RSVP websites for events, clean, on-brand, and matching the stationery suite.

~ Helping refine and execute logo concepts I bring you. Cleaning vectors, building variations, testing at different sizes, tightening curves.

~ Vectorising.

~ File prep and organisation. Keeping my design library tidy and consistent.

~ General design work across both businesses as we build a rhythm and confidence.



***A quick note on AI: I'm not against it as a little helper along the way! But the design itself has to come from you and your skills, not from AI doing the heavy lifting. I can always tell the difference. I'll also always need working files I can open and edit, so the real work has to be there underneath.***



WHAT I AM LOOKING FOR



~ Strong in Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop. This is non-negotiable, you live in these every day.

~ Comfortable in Canva too, especially for the RSVP websites and quick-turnaround pieces.

~ A genuinely good eye for layout and type. You notice when something's off.

~ You get aesthetic direction quickly. My studio has a specific look, and you don't need to design in that style yourself, but you do need to see it and stay true to it when you adapt my work!

~ Fast and reliable with communication. I hate chasing people, and you need to speak and write English well.

~ You follow direction well, but you're not a robot. You'll flag it if something looks wrong!

~ Clean, organised file habits.

~ You're open to collaboration and communication. I'm always up for ideas and suggestions on the design work, so I want someone who'll actually engage!



TO APPLY, SEND ME:



1. Your portfolio! A link please, not attachments.

2. In a line or two, tell me what kind of design work you most enjoy and why. I'd love to get a feel for you.

title: Creative Strategist (Performance Marketing) [Singapore Company]
description:
Creative Strategist — KYOR (Performance Creative)



1) About Us



Symple Wellness created KYOR, a science-backed wellness brand focused on clean formulations, clinically studied ingredients, and real results.



Our hero product line is designed to simplify skincare and boost whole-body wellness — empowering individuals to glow confidently from the inside out.



Website: kyor.co/



We are rapidly expanding, especially in the US market, and we're looking for a sharp, analytical, performance-driven **Creative Strategist** who lives and breathes paid social. This is the person who d
 *what* we say, *who* we say it to, and *why* it'll convert — then writes the briefs that turn that thinking into ads our designers and editors can build.



You won't be pushing pixels in Photoshop all day. Your output is the strategy and the brief: the angle, the persona, the hook, the concept, the shotlist. The visuals follow your thinking. This is one of the highest-leverage roles on the team — get the brief right and everything downstream scales; get it wrong and we burn spend on beautiful ads that don't sell.



2) What You'll Do



- Write 20+ creative briefs per week that translate strategy into clear, buildable direction for designers and video editors across Meta (Feed, Reels, Stories), TikTok, and other platforms

- Develop distinct messaging angles mapped to specific personas, pain points, and awareness stages — not "glow from within" mush, but sharp, differentiated concepts that filter for the right buyer

- Research relentlessly: tear down competitor ads, build and maintain swipe files, study what's winning in beauty/wellness feeds, and reverse-engineer *why* it works

- Define hooks, concepts, and formats for each brief — including the first 3 seconds, the scroll-stopper, and the CTA

- Write UGC scripts, listicle scripts, and shotlists when a brief needs them, and spec AI image/video prompts clearly enough that a designer can execute without guessing

- Partner with designers, copywriters, and our influencer/KOL team to ideate and pressure-test concepts before they go into production

- Read the data and let it drive the next brief: hook rate, CTR, CPA, ROAS, thumbstop. Kill what's losing, double down on what's winning, and brief accordingly

- Build and extend the frameworks, templates, and naming conventions that let the team move fast and stay organised



 3) What You Bring



**Must-haves**



- 2+ year working on paid social creative — as a strategist, brief-writer, media buyer who briefs creative, UGC strategist, agency creative, or a strong self-directed track record (your own ads, teardowns, or a brand you've run creative for all count)

- Strategic thinking with an actual framework — you reach for persona ? pain ? angle ? hook ? format, not vibes. When you watch an ad you can say *precisely* why it works or doesn't

- Strong, clear writing. A brief is only useful if a designer can build from it without a meeting. You write tight, specific, and unambiguous

- Working understanding of how paid social performs: what hook rate, CTR, CPA, and ROAS mean, and how creative moves them

- The ability to generate volume, not just curate. Performance creative is a numbers game — you can produce 15 hooks fast, then know which 3 are worth shooting

- Comfort taking direct, critical feedback and iterating without ego. The job is briefing creative against data feedback every single week, often when the data says your favourite concept flopped. You revise, you don't sulk

- Hungry to learn, genuinely curious about why people buy, and energised by the idea that your work is measured by performance, not praise



 4) AI Proficiency (required)



We expect everyone on this team to use AI to think faster, research deeper, and produce more. You should already be comfortable with — or eager to learn — the tools we use day to day:



- **Ideation, research & brief-writing:** ChatGPT, Claude, or similar — for brainstorming angles, structuring briefs, analysing reviews and competitor ads, and pressure-testing concepts

- **Prompt engineering for production:** you can write image/video prompts precise enough for a designer to run through Nano Banana (Google Gemini's image model), ChatGPT Images, Seedance 2.0, or Veo 3 and get usable output

- **Workflow:** you use AI to compress research and first drafts so you spend your time on the thinking that matters, not the busywork



In the interview process, you'll be asked to show how AI actually shows up in your workflow — not that you've tried these tools, but how you've integrated them into how you strategise and write. If you haven't used our exact stack, that's fine — you should have hands-on experience with comparable tools and be ready to pick ours up quickly.



**Nice-to-haves**



- Personal interest in beauty, wellness, or skincare (you're a KYOR target customer or close to one)

- Familiarity with supplement/beauty compliance — claim substantiation, on-label mechanism language, the difference between a sellable claim and a liability

- Experience with Meta Ads Manager, creative testing, or structured ad scorecards

- Hands-on UGC and influencer/KOL experience — scripting, shotlists, working with creators

- An eye for art direction — you can't make the ad, but you know what good looks like and can point a designer toward it



## 5) How to Apply



Send the following to 
 with the subject line: "I Am Your Creative Strategist — [Your Name]"



- Your CV

- A link to your work — a portfolio, swipe deck, ad teardown thread, briefs you've written, ads you've strategised, or a brand you've run creative for (Behance, Notion, Google Drive, PDF, or social all fine)

- A 3–5 sentence note on which AI tools you currently use in your strategy/research workflow and how



We respond to every application within 5 working days. Shortlisted candidates will go through a short three-round process: a 15-minute personality profiling assessment, followed by 2 strategy tests to understand how you think.

description:
Medical Credentialing Specialist

Reports To:  CEO

Employment Type:  Full-Time

Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced Senior Medical Credentialing Specialist to own and lead the credentialing function for our practice with minimal day-to-day supervision. This person will manage the full credentialing and payer enrollment lifecycle for all providers, partner closely with the billing team to keep providers compliant and in-network, and serve as the subject-matter expert the rest of the team relies on.

In addition to leading credentialing, this role supports our front desk operations. The specialist will answer phones and schedule patient appointments when calls roll over from the front desk, and will step in to support other front-desk functions as needed. The ideal candidate is highly organized, self-directed, and comfortable balancing detailed compliance work with patient-facing support.

Key Responsibilities

Credentialing & Provider Enrollment (Primary)

• Take charge of the practice's credentialing operations independently, managing the complete lifecycle for all providers from initial credentialing through re-credentialing.

• Complete and submit initial credentialing, re-credentialing, and payer enrollment applications for commercial and government payers (Medicare, Medicaid, and managed care plans).

• Maintain and update provider profiles in CAQH ProView, PECOS, NPPES/NPI, and payer portals, ensuring all information is accurate and current.

• Perform primary source verification of licenses, education, training, board certifications, work history, and malpractice coverage.

• Track and proactively manage expirables — state licenses, DEA registrations, board certifications, malpractice insurance, and other time-sensitive credentials — and renew them ahead of deadlines to prevent lapses.

• Maintain organized, audit-ready provider files and credentialing records in compliance with applicable standards (e.g., NCQA, Joint Commission, CMS, and payer requirements).

• Monitor application status, follow up persistently with payers, and resolve issues to keep enrollment moving and minimize delays.

• Serve as the internal point of contact and resource on credentialing questions, escalations, and process improvements.





Billing & Compliance Collaboration

• Prior experience in a lead or senior credentialing role.

Core Competencies

• Detail & accuracy — treats deadlines and documentation as non-negotiable.

• Collaboration — works seamlessly across credentialing, billing, and front-desk teams.

• Adaptability — moves comfortably between focused compliance work and patient-facing support.

• Customer service — represents the practice professionally to patients and payers alike.

Work Environment & Physical Requirements

• Standard medical office environment.

• Extended periods of computer and phone work.

• Occasional reaching, lifting of office materials, and movement throughout the office to support front-desk coverage.

title: AI Savvy Operations Assistant
description:
Hi! My name's Ajay, and I'm the founder of a SaaS company in the
 space called GMass.

 

I'm looking for an AI-savvy operations executive that can help me run the company and my personal life..  My company, GMass, makes software that turns a Gmail account into an
 marketing platform. For the last 12 years, I've been grinding away on all the things that a techy CEO of a promising startup does: coding, marketing, sales, support, administration, responding to
…oh boy, so much

 company. 



I need some help with all the busy-work so I can get back to building our product and growing the company.

  

 About the person I seek:

 

The person I seek will take control of tasks and projects related to GMass and my personal life, and these items span multiple disciplines from operations to customer support to negotiation on the GMass side to logistical planning and domestic staff management on the personal side.



 Skills I'd like you to have coming into this role:

 

Outbound
: You should understand the fundamentals of
 outreach, either having worked for an
 Service Provider, or having coordinated cold or opt-in 
 campaigns for an organization.



Writing: You must have a strong grasp of written English. You should be able to write excellent prose without the use of AI. I consider myself a good writer, and you should  be able to write as well or better than me so you can communicate on my behalf. You’ll be managing my Inbox and replying to
s in my voice.



Spoken English: You should be able to converse in English, so that you can participate in phone calls and video meetings.

You must have a strong grasp of AI tools and their capabilities. In fact, you should already be using AI tools in your daily life.

 

If we can travel back in time two months, and you were working with me then, here are some actual projects I’d assign to you:

 

We have a series of
 campaigns we need to send to our user-base of 1-million+ users. Wait until our content producer is finished with the content, then prep, schedule, and monitor all of the campaigns. Then, reply to everyone that replies to the campaign.

Go through the last six months of
s in my Inbox and reply to anyone needing a reply.

A big customer has reached out directly to me and they're upset because they feel like the support team hasn't adequately addressed the issue. Dig in, find out what's going on, and solve the issue for the customer.

I need to plan an in-person retreat for my small leadership team. We need hotels, flights, dinners, and a space to collaborate. Can you plan it?

The lease on my car is ending next month. I would usually lease a new car, but interest rates are higher than they've ever been since I started driving cars. Is leasing or buying the better option now?

I’ve d

While lots of job ads ask for "a self starter" and "a team player" and "someone that can multitask" and "some with attention to detail" and "someone who's organized", I find all those requirements silly, because everyone in the workforce should have those skills. title: Email Marketing
description:
We're a hospitality group running four brands: An oat-milk espresso martini beverage brand, and three restaurants in Little Italy, San Diego. We have a combined
 list of tens of thousands of guests collected over the years that has never been
ed. We're building an
 marketing program from the ground up and need an experienced specialist to own the execution.



This is a real opportunity to take a clean slate and turn it into a high-performing revenue channel. You'll be hands-on across all four brands.



What you'll do



Technical setup & deliverability: Configure a dedicated sending domain, set up SPF, DKIM, and DMARC authentication, and run list cleaning and verification to remove dead and risky addresses before they hurt our sender reputation.



List warm-up: Because these lists have never been
ed, you'll rebuild sender reputation the right way — starting with the most recent signups, sending in small daily batches, and ramping volume as engagement holds. No reckless blasts.



Re-introduction campaign: Build and deploy a "we're finally in your inbox" re-introduction
 for each brand. Goal: rebuild reputation, identify the engaged core, and set a clean baseline.



Templates & design: Create on-brand, mobile-first, reusable
 templates for each of the four brands.



Segmentation: Segment by brand, engagement level, and behavior so the right people get the right message.



Campaigns: Plan, build, and deploy ongoing campaigns — seasonal promotions, events, new menu launches, gift cards, private dining, and more.



Flows & automations: Build and maintain automated flows — welcome series, birthday, win-back, and post-visit follow-ups.



Loyalty: Help design and run loyalty / rewards programs that drive repeat visits.



Reporting: Track open rates, click rates, and revenue, and report on what's working and what to change next.





What we're looking for



Proven Klaviyo experience - you've set up accounts, built flows and campaigns, and can show results.

Strong deliverability knowledge - domain authentication (SPF/DKIM/DMARC), list cleaning, and warming a cold or dormant list without wrecking sender reputation.

Above-average results - you can point to open rates and click-through rates that beat industry benchmarks (restaurant industry averages are ~43% open / ~1.1% CTR — we want better).

 design skills - you can build clean, mobile-first templates that look on-brand, not generic.

Segmentation and automation - comfortable building flows, segments, and A/B tests.

Loyalty program experience - bonus if you've built or run one before.

Self-starter — organized, communicative, and able to own the program with light oversight.

Strong written English -  you'll be writing subject lines and
 copy (or closely editing it).





Nice to have

Restaurant, hospitality, food & beverage, or DTC experience.

Experience migrating or building a Klaviyo account from scratch.

Copywriting ability.





How to apply

To show you actually read this post, please start your application with the word "ESPRESSO" at the top.

In your application, include:



A short intro about your
 marketing experience and which tools you've used.

Links to or screenshots of Klaviyo flows, campaigns, or templates you've built (portfolio).

Your typical open rate and click-through rate, and how you achieved them.

A brief description of how you would safely warm up a 40,000-person list that has never been
ed.

Your weekly availability and any overlap you can offer with US Pacific time.



Strong performers will get more hours and responsibility as the program grows.



We're excited to find the right person - looking forward to your application!

title: Media Buyer Needed — Strategic Proposal Request for Paid Ads Launch
description:
Media Buyer Needed — Strategic Proposal Request for Paid Ads Launch



Background



We are looking for an experienced media buyer to review our offer and provide a clear campaign proposal outlining how you would launch, test, and scale paid advertising for our business.



Our Meta ad account / Instagram account is currently suspended, and Meta has been experiencing significant account restrictions and ban waves. Because of this, we are looking for a media buyer who can objectively assess our situation and recommend the most viable platform and strategy based on current market conditions rather than defaulting to a single advertising channel.



We are not looking for someone to simply "run ads." We are looking for a strategic partner who can evaluate our situation, recommend the best path forward, and provide a well-thought-out acquisition plan before any campaign begins.







Business Context



Our offer is a done-for-you prop firm passing service targeted toward aspiring traders and individuals who have struggled to successfully pass prop firm evaluations on their own.



Our audience primarily consists of:



 Aspiring funded traders

 Traders who have previously failed prop firm challenges

 Individuals interested in trading as an income-generating skill

 Traders seeking assistance navigating the prop firm evaluation process



Because this is a trading-related offer, please clearly state whether you have previous experience advertising within the trading, forex, futures, crypto, investing, prop firm, funded account, or financial education industries. If applicable, please include relevant case studies, performance metrics, lessons learned, and any compliance or advertising challenges you have encountered within these industries.







 Business Stage



This is a new business launch.



We currently have:



 No previous ad campaign data

 No historical CPA benchmarks

 No historical ROAS benchmarks

 No existing pixel or conversion data

 No proven winning audiences

 No established retargeting pools

 No prior paid traffic results



We understand that the initial campaign phase will involve testing, validation, audience discovery, creative testing, and data collection. We are specifically looking for a media buyer who can create a realistic launch strategy for a business starting from scratch and explain how they would progress from initial testing to a scalable acquisition system.





 Budget



We are starting with a budget of approximately $1,000–$1,500 for Month 1.



This is intended as an initial testing budget and is not our long-term ceiling. If performance supports scaling, we are prepared to increase spend beginning in Month 2 and continue scaling in subsequent months.







 What We Need From You



Please submit a proposal that includes the following:



 1. Recommended Platform



 Which platform would you launch on first?

 Why do you believe this platform is the best fit for our offer, audience, budget, and current account situation?

 If recommending TikTok, YouTube, Google, Meta (if available), X, or another platform, explain your reasoning.



 2. Launch Strategy



Please explain:



 Campaign structure

 Targeting approach

 Creative strategy

 Funnel structure

Website sales vs. DMs vs. lead generation

 Testing methodology



 3. Forecast & Performance Expectations



Please provide realistic projections for:



 Month 1



 Month 2



 Month 3



Include estimated:



 Traffic volume

 Clicks

 Conversions

 Cost per result

 Customer acquisition cost

 Revenue projections

 ROAS assumptions

 Key risks and assumptions behind the forecast



 4. Scaling Plan



Please explain:



 How you would determine whether a campaign is ready to scale

 What KPIs you would monitor

 Budget increases you would recommend

 How strategy would evolve between Month 1, Month 2, and Month 3



 5. Creative & Testing Strategy



Please outline:



 What creative formats you would test first

 Number of ad variations

 Hooks and messaging angles

 Creative testing framework

 Any additional assets you would recommend creating



 6. Risk & Compliance Considerations



Because this is a trading-related offer, please explain:



 Potential advertising risks

 Platform-specific restrictions

 Compliance concerns

 How you would minimize the likelihood of ad disapprovals, account issues, or policy violations







 Additional Information To Include



Please also provide:



 Relevant experience

 Similar industries worked with

 Case studies or performance examples

 Management fee and what is included

 Whether you provide strategy, copywriting, creative direction, or creative production

 Expected timeline to launch

Communication and reporting process







 Proposal Requirements



Please do not submit generic proposals.



We are specifically looking for:



 A recommended platform selection with supporting reasoning

 A launch plan tailored to our business

 Month 1–3 projections

 Budget allocation recommendations

 Expected KPIs and success metrics

 Scaling methodology

 Risks and assumptions behind your forecast



The stronger your strategic thinking, the more likely you are to be considered.





 Decision Criteria



We will not necessarily choose the lowest-cost media buyer.



We will select the candidate who demonstrates the strongest understanding of:



 Paid acquisition strategy

 Forecasting and performance expectations

 Platform selection

 Scaling methodology

 Risk management

 Performance marketing fundamentals



The quality of your proposal, reasoning, and strategic approach will be a major factor in our decision.





To Apply



Please send:



A brief introduction

Your proposed platform and reasoning

 Month 1–3 projections

 Your fee structure

 Relevant case studies or proof of results

Any additional recommendations you believe we should consider



We look forward to reviewing thoughtful, data-driven proposals from experienced media buyers who can help us build a scalable acquisition strategy from the ground up.

title: Podcast Audio Editor — Low Five Gaming
description:
Podcast Audio Editor — Low Five Gaming



Low Five Gaming is a retro and indie gaming podcast hosted by two brothers out of Minneapolis. We talk about the games we grew up on, the ones we're playing now, and everything in between. We're looking for a reliable audio editor to clean up and polish our episodes on a per-episode basis.



This is gig work. You'll be paid per episode on a consistent schedule. If you're good and easy to work with, this is a relationship that grows.



WHAT THE JOB INVOLVES



Audio editing for each episode — cleanup, noise reduction, cuts, leveling, and drop-in of intro and outro. You'll also tastefully weave in segment transitions, short song clips, and occasional game audio throughout each episode. We'll provide direction on where and what, but you'll need a good ear for how to make it land naturally. You're not sourcing music or building anything from scratch. You're making us sound clean, tight, and professional.



Episodes run approximately one hour. We release one to three episodes per month.



One thing worth saying plainly: we want a real editor. If your process runs everything through an AI tool and calls it done, this isn't the right fit. We can tell the difference and it matters to us.



THE DETAILS



Rate: $15 per episode

Type: Gig work, paid per episode

100% remote



TO APPLY



Tell us a little about your background in audio editing and share any podcasts you've worked on. Walk us through your editing process — we're genuinely interested in how you work. Links or examples are welcome. Two questions we ask everyone to make sure they've read this far: what's your favorite video game of all time, and what podcast are you enjoying right now? Include both answers in your application.



We're looking forward to hearing from you.

title: Clinic Manager
description:
About Us

We’re building a global talent pool of experienced Clinic Managers to support partner clinics across Australia, the US, the UK, New Zealand, and beyond. These clinics deliver modern healthcare services on-site, often combining general practice with wellness, integrative care, and allied health support.



Our shared mission is simple: make healthcare more human—patient-first service, reliable systems, calm communication, and consistent quality.



If you’re an operations leader who can bring structure to busy clinic workflows (and keep standards high), we’d love to meet you.



Role Overview

As a Clinic Manager (In-Clinic Operations), you’ll oversee day-to-day clinic operations and ensure the front desk, patient flow, and administrative systems run smoothly. You’ll coordinate staff, improve processes, handle escalations, and monitor performance—so clinicians can focus on care and patients feel supported.



This is a pooling / talent pipeline role. Successful candidates may be matched to clinic openings based on:

 • Your operations and people-leadership experience

 • Your clinic setting background (primary care, allied health, wellness, specialty)

 • Tools you’ve used (practice management software, scheduling, billing, CRM/ticketing)

 • Compensation alignment and scope (single site vs multi-site support)



Medical allied licensure is an advantage but not required. Strong clinic management experience is the priority.



What You’ll Do (Key Responsibilities)

 • Run daily clinic operations: reception workflow, scheduling flow, staff coverage, and service readiness.

 • Lead and coach admin/front desk teams (and other support roles as assigned) with clear standards and accountability.

 • Ensure an excellent patient experience: timely communication, accurate bookings, smooth check-in/check-out processes.

 • Manage appointment scheduling processes to reduce gaps and improve utilization.

 • Oversee documentation and admin accuracy in practice systems (patient profiles, consent forms, required documentation).

 • Support billing/admin coordination (invoicing workflows, payment follow-ups, basic reconciliation support) depending on clinic assignment.

 • Handle escalations: complaints, service recovery, and sensitive patient situations with professionalism.

 • Build and maintain SOPs, scripts, and checklists to standardize operations.

 • Monitor KPIs and report weekly: patient volume, cancellations/no-shows, response time, revenue/admin indicators (where applicable), and CSAT/NPS.

 • Coordinate with clinicians for operational needs (rosters, room allocation, prep requirements, follow-ups).

 • Support hiring, onboarding, training, and QA for admin workflows.

 • Ensure privacy-minded operations and secure handling of patient information.



Must-Have Qualifications

 • 5+ years experience in clinic management / healthcare administration / practice operations (or similar).

 • Proven people leadership experience (team supervision, coaching, performance management).

 • Strong English communication (spoken and written); confident working with international stakeholders.

 • Strong operational mindset: workflow design, SOPs, problem-solving, and prioritization.

 • Comfortable with practice management systems and admin workflows (scheduling, patient records, basic billing coordination).

 • Data-driven: able to track KPIs, spot trends, and improve performance.

 • Remote-ready: reliable attendance, proactive communication, and accountability.

 • Reliable home setup: stable internet, quiet workspace, headset, and backup plan.



Nice-to-Haves (Bonus Points)

 • Medical allied health license/background (advantage, not required).

 • Experience supporting multi-site clinics or regional operations.

 • Strong patient experience and complaint handling/service recovery experience.

 • Familiarity with compliance-minded documentation workflows (consent tracking, ID checks, required forms).

 • Experience with clinics in AU/UK/US/NZ systems and service expectations.

 • Advanced Excel/Sheets reporting and dashboarding.



Tools/Systems Familiarity (Examples)

 • Practice management / scheduling: clinic software varies by site (experience with any is transferable)

 • Billing/admin tools: invoicing and payment tools (clinic-specific)

 • CRM/ticketing: HubSpot, Zendesk, Freshdesk (optional per site)

 • Ops: Google Workspace, Slack/Teams, Notion/Trello/Asana, Google Sheets



Work Setup & Scheduling (PH-based)

 • Location: Philippines (remote)

 • Shift options: Vary by clinic assignment based on local clinic hours

 • AU/NZ-friendly (PH day shift)

 • UK-friendly (PH late afternoon/evening)

 • US-friendly (PH night shift)

 • Preference for candidates who can commit to consistent overlap windows and provide clear handoffs and reporting.



Compensation (General Guidance)

 • Starting at USD 15/hour, negotiable based on:

 • team size managed

 • complexity (single site vs multi-site operations support)

 • KPI ownership (utilization, cancellations/no-shows, CSAT, admin accuracy)

 • SOP/process improvement capability

 • Some assignments may include performance bonuses tied to operational outcomes.



How to Apply (Required)

Please submit:

 1. CV / Resume

 2. A short video introduction (1–2 minutes) covering:

 • Your clinic management/operations experience (setting + team size)

 • Tools/systems you’ve used (scheduling/practice management/billing/CRM)

 • Your preferred shift overlap (AU/UK/US)

 • One operational improvement you led and the result (numbers if possible)



Optional but helpful:

 • A sample SOP/checklist you created (remove any sensitive information)

 • Summary of KPIs you’ve managed (utilization, cancellations/no-shows, CSAT/NPS, billing accuracy)



Our Screening Process (What to Expect)

 • Initial screen (leadership + communication + remote readiness)

 • Practical task: propose an SOP + KPI plan for a sample clinic workflow issue

 • Structured interview: scenarios on escalations, coaching, metrics, and process improvement



Join the Pool

If you’re a steady, patient-first operations leader who can bring clarity and consistency to busy clinic workflows, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Medical Scribe / Documentation QA (EHR Quality)
description:
About Us

We’re building a global talent pool of exceptional remote Medical Scribes / Documentation QA Specialists to support partner clinics across Australia, the US, the UK, New Zealand, and beyond. These clinics deliver modern healthcare through telehealth and digital services—often combining general practice with wellness, integrative care, and allied health support.



Our shared mission is simple: make healthcare more human—by supporting clinicians with accurate, consistent documentation so patients receive safe, continuous care and clinics can operate with confidence.



If you’re detail-oriented, privacy-minded, and love creating clean, clinician-ready charts, we’d love to meet you.



Role Overview

As a Medical Scribe / Documentation QA (EHR Quality), you’ll help ensure patient charts are complete, accurate, and easy for clinicians to use. Depending on clinic assignment, your work may include real-time or near-real-time scribing during telehealth visits, post-visit documentation cleanup, and ongoing chart audits to maintain consistent standards.



This is a pooling/talent pipeline role. Successful candidates may be matched to open roles with clinics based on:

 • Your scribing and documentation experience (telehealth, in-person, specialty exposure)

 • Your preferred shift coverage (AU/UK/US)

 • EHR systems you’ve used (or your ability to learn quickly)

 • Compensation alignment and expected workload volume

Note: You do not provide medical advice. You support documentation quality, workflow efficiency, and compliance-minded recordkeeping.



What You’ll Do (Key Responsibilities)

 • Create or refine visit documentation using clinic templates (e.g., SOAP, HPI, ROS, assessment, plan, patient instructions).

 • Scribe during or immediately after telehealth visits when assigned (accurate, concise, clinician-ready).

 • QA charts for completeness: required fields, signatures, coding support fields (if applicable), and follow-up tasks.

 • Standardize formatting and terminology while preserving the clinician’s intent and clinical accuracy.

 • Ensure documentation supports continuity of care: clear next steps, follow-up timelines, and patient education notes.

 • Flag missing information or documentation risks to clinicians using a structured escalation workflow.

 • Maintain consistent use of tags, problem lists, medication lists, allergies, and history updates (per policy).

 • Support clinic documentation standards: macros, templates, smart phrases, and style guides.

 • Perform periodic chart audits (sample-based) and report trends: common misses, training needs, template gaps.

 • Coordinate asynchronously with clinicians and ops teams for corrections and handoffs.

 • Protect patient privacy and follow confidentiality/security practices at all times.



Must-Have Qualifications

 • 3+ years of experience in medical scribing, clinical documentation, medical transcription, chart auditing, or similar healthcare documentation roles.

 • Strong written English with excellent grammar and ability to summarize accurately.

 • Familiarity with medical terminology and common documentation structures (SOAP, HPI, etc.).

 • High attention to detail—able to spot inconsistencies, missing fields, and documentation gaps.

 • Comfort working inside EHR/EMR systems and following structured templates.

 • Ability to work fast without sacrificing accuracy, especially under time pressure.

 • Strong privacy mindset (healthcare confidentiality, minimum necessary access, secure handling).

 • Remote-ready: reliable attendance, self-management, and proactive communication.

 • Reliable home setup: quiet workspace, stable internet, and secure device practices.



Nice-to-Haves (Bonus Points)

 • Telehealth scribing experience (live or near-live).

 • Experience with any EHR/EMR (e.g., Best Practice, Halaxy, SimplePractice, Athena, DrChrono, Kareo, Practice Better, etc.).

 • Experience supporting multiple specialties (primary care, allied health, integrative care, mental health, pain, sleep).

 • Familiarity with documentation compliance expectations and chart audit processes.

 • Exposure to ICD-10/CPT basics or clinical coding support (not required; depends on clinic assignment).

 • Strong template-building skills (macros, smart phrases, standard note formats).

 • Experience working with international teams and time zone handoffs.



Tools/Systems Familiarity (Examples)

 • EHR/EMR: any system (training provided per clinic); comfort learning new workflows quickly

 • Collaboration: Google Workspace, Slack/Teams, Notion/Trello/Asana

 • Documentation aids: approved templates, smart phrases/macros (clinic-specific)

 • Voice (if used): VoIP platforms for live visits (clinic-specific)



Work Setup & Scheduling (PH-based)

 • Location: Philippines (remote)

 • Shift options: Vary by clinic assignment

 • AU/NZ-friendly (PH day shift)

 • UK-friendly (PH late afternoon/evening)

 • US-friendly (PH night shift)

 • Preference for candidates who can commit to consistent overlap windows and provide clear async updates.



Compensation (General Guidance)

Starts at USD 10/hour. Higher rates may apply for:

 • strong scribing track record (telehealth/live)

 • demonstrated QA/auditing experience

 • speed + accuracy at volume

 • experience building documentation templates/macros

Some clinics may offer incentives based on accuracy and turnaround time.



How to Apply (Required)

Please submit:

 1. CV / Resume

 2. A short video introduction (1–2 minutes) covering:

 • Your documentation/scribing background

 • EHR systems you’ve used (or how you learn new ones fast)

 • Your preferred shift overlap (AU/UK/US)

 • Your approach to accuracy, privacy, and fast turnaround

 3. Optional but strongly recommended: 1–2 anonymized writing samples (remove all identifying/patient data), such as:

 • a sample SOAP note you created, or

 • a “before/after” documentation cleanup example



Important: Do not submit any document containing real patient identifiers.



Our Screening Process (What to Expect)

 • Initial screen (English writing + documentation experience + remote readiness)

 • Practical test (timed): create a structured note from a mock transcript + QA checklist

title: Power BI Report Specialist - Remote
description:
Foresight Environmental is seeking an experienced Power BI Report Specialist to help us build a growing library of professional, client-ready Power BI and paginated reports.



You will work with our Australian operations, data and technology team to turn business reporting requirements into polished Power BI reports that are accurate, reusable, well documented and ready for release to clients.



About Foresight Environmental

Foresight Environmental is an Australian environmental services and sustainability business. We help property owners, managers and organisations improve the way they manage waste, data, reporting and environmental performance.

We are expanding our internal reporting capability and want to develop a repeatable report library that supports internal delivery and future client reporting releases.



About the Role

You will design, build, test and maintain Power BI reports, dashboards, paginated reports, templates and reusable reporting assets.



The role will involve working with data from our Synthesis Portal, Dynamics 365, Excel, SharePoint, SQL databases, APIs and other approved sources. This is not a basic dashboard role. We need someone who can combine strong technical Power BI skills with excellent visual design judgement and disciplined data transformation practices.



Key Responsibilities

Power BI Report Development

•  Design, build and maintain Power BI reports and dashboards for internal and client-facing use.

•  Create clear, professional report layouts that are suitable for client release.

•  Translate report examples, sketches, briefs and business requirements into working Power BI outputs.

•  Develop reusable report templates, page layouts, visual patterns, themes and components.

•  Apply good judgement to filters, navigation, bookmarks, drill-through, interactivity and user experience.



Paginated Reporting

•  Build paginated reports using Power BI Report Builder / Microsoft Report Builder.

•  Create fixed-format reports for PDF, Excel and structured client reporting packs.

•  Design and maintain parameters, grouped tables, summary sections, headers, footers, page breaks and export layouts.

•  Test rendering, pagination, formatting, export behaviour and data accuracy before handover.



Power Query, Data Modelling and Data Quality

•  Build advanced Power Query transformations to cleanse, merge, shape and prepare reporting data.

•  Support semantic model development, including relationships, measures, calculations and DAX.

•  Use SQL and relational database concepts to validate data and investigate reporting issues.

•  Identify data gaps, anomalies and risks, then escalate them clearly with proposed next steps.

•  Document report logic, data sources, assumptions, refresh steps and dependencies.



Report Library Development

•  Help build a reusable library of standardised Power BI reports for Foresight clients.

•  Work with the internal team to understand where required data is stored and how it should be interpreted.

•  Develop repeatable reporting processes that reduce rework and improve consistency.

•  Contribute to better reporting standards, data definitions, documentation and client-ready analytics.

•  Assist with the development and ongoing support of our report delivery frameworks.



Required Skills

You must have strong experience with:

•  Power BI Desktop and Power BI Service.

•  Advanced Power Query, including complex transformations, merges, parameters, error handling and reusable queries.

•  Paginated reports using Power BI Report Builder / Microsoft Report Builder.

•  Client-ready report layout, visual design and data storytelling.

•  Data modelling, relationships, DAX measures and semantic models.

•  SQL and relational database concepts.

•  Working with imperfect, evolving or multiple data sources.

•  Testing, documentation and remote communication.



Bonus Skills / Experience

These are not essential, but will be a big advantage:

•  Power Automate experience, including flows, connectors, approvals, notifications and data movement.

• Power Apps experience, including canvas apps, model-driven apps, Dataverse and structured data collection.

•  Power Pages experience for external forms, portals or stakeholder data capture.

•  Experience with SharePoint, Dataverse, Dynamics 365, Power BI Gateways, Dataflows or Microsoft Fabric.

•  Experience building reporting products or report libraries for external clients.

•  API-based data ingestion, data governance, version control or lightweight data engineering experience.

•  Exposure to waste, environmental services, sustainability reporting, property operations or consulting environments.



Work Hours and Setup

•  Remote role - Philippines-based applicants preferred.

•  Approximately 20-30 hours per week initially, with potential to increase to 40 hours per week.

•  Must be available for regular overlap with Australian business hours.

•  Must have a Windows PC or laptop suitable for Power BI development.

•  Must have a second monitor.

•  Must have a stable internet connection and a quiet working environment.

•  Must be punctual, reliable, proactive and consistent.



Who We Are Looking For

•  Someone who takes pride in producing polished, professional reports.

•  Someone with strong attention to detail and a structured approach to testing.

•  Someone who can work independently from a clear brief.

•  Someone who communicates clearly when blocked or unsure.

•  Someone who can turn messy or incomplete data into structured reporting outputs.

•  Someone who understands that report design is about usability, accuracy, layout and client presentation.

•  Someone who documents their work so reports can be maintained and reused.



**How to Apply**

Please use at least 10 Apply Points for your application to be considered. 

Please send the following to 
 with the subject line: Power BI Report Specialist Application.

1.  Your updated resume in Word or PDF format. The file name must include your name.

2.  A 1-2 minute introduction video walking us through your CV, your Power BI / Power Query / paginated reporting experience, and why you are suitable for this role.

3.  Links or screenshots showing examples of your Power BI work, including report layouts, dashboards, paginated reports or relevant portfolio work where possible. Please remove or hide confidential client data.

4.  Your preferred number of hours per week and your likely availability in Sydney / Melbourne time.

5.  Your expected hourly rate or monthly salary in PHP or AUD.

6.  A photo of your workstation showing your computer setup, including your second monitor.

Applications that do not include these items will not be considered. Applicants who have previously applied for a role with us are welcome to re-apply.



We look forward to hearing from someone awesome who loves Power BI, clean data and building reports that people actually want to use.

title: LinkedIn Client Acquisition Specialist (Coaching Business)
description:
# LinkedIn Client Acquisition Specialist | Help Build an American English Coaching Business



## Part-Time (10 Hours/Week)



### Help me build the client acquisition system for a growing coaching business.



Hi! My name is Chevy.



I'm building a premium American English pronunciation coaching business that helps Spanish-speaking professionals communicate with more confidence in English.



My clients are engineers, healthcare professionals, researchers, managers, finance professionals, and other skilled professionals who already speak English well—but want to speak more clearly, understand native English more easily, and communicate with greater confidence at work.



I already have someone responsible for growing my LinkedIn network.



**Now I'm looking for someone who can help turn those connections into paying clients.**



This is **NOT** a traditional Virtual Assistant role.



I'm looking for someone who enjoys sales psychology, relationship building, and genuine conversations.



Someone who understands that people don't buy coaching because they're pressured—they buy because they feel understood.



If you're excited about helping build a real business from the ground up, I'd love to meet you.



---



# Your Mission



Your mission is simple:



Help me consistently book qualified pronunciation diagnostics with Spanish-speaking professionals.



You'll be communicating through my LinkedIn account, building authentic conversations, identifying professionals who could genuinely benefit from my coaching, and helping them schedule a free pronunciation diagnostic with me.



I personally conduct every diagnostic and coaching session.



Your role is to build trust, create conversations, and keep my calendar full of qualified prospects.



---



# Who We Help



We help Spanish-speaking professionals who already speak English but struggle with things like:



• Being asked to repeat themselves



• Speaking confidently during meetings



• Presentations



• Job interviews



• Communicating with clients



• Understanding fast native English



Many of them have spent years studying grammar but have never received professional pronunciation coaching.



---



# What You'll Do



• Start conversations with new LinkedIn connections



• Follow up with older connections



• Re-engage conversations that have gone cold



• Build relationships (not spam)



• Learn about each person's English communication goals



• Identify qualified prospects



• Invite them to book a free pronunciation diagnostic



• Keep our CRM organized



• Suggest improvements to messaging, follow-up strategy, and client acquisition



I want someone who thinks strategically—not someone who simply follows a script.



---



# What Success Looks Like



Your success will NOT be measured by:



? Messages sent



? Hours worked



? Number of conversations



Your success will be measured by:



? Qualified pronunciation diagnostics booked



? Diagnostics that actually show up



? Paying clients generated



---



# Compensation



• Part-time (approximately 10 hours/week)



• Hourly pay



• Performance bonus for every qualified pronunciation diagnostic that attends



• Additional commission for every client who enrolls after their diagnostic



If you consistently help grow the business, I expect this role to grow as well.



I'm looking for someone who wants to become a long-term part of the business as we continue to scale.



---



# Who I'm Looking For



You may be an excellent fit if you've worked as a:



• LinkedIn Client Acquisition Specialist



• Appointment Setter



• Sales Development Representative (SDR)



• Business Development Representative (BDR)



• High-Ticket Appointment Setter



Experience working with coaches, consultants, online education, or service businesses is a huge plus.



More important than your title, though, is your ability to build genuine conversations that naturally lead to booked appointments.



---



# Application Instructions



To show me you've carefully read this description, begin your application with the words:



**"Speech First."**



Then answer the following:



1. Tell me about your appointment-setting experience.



2. Have you booked appointments using LinkedIn before?



3. Tell me about the most successful client acquisition campaign you've worked on.



4. A prospect replies:



> "Your coaching sounds interesting. Can you tell me more?"



Write the next **three LinkedIn messages** you would send with the goal of naturally booking a free pronunciation diagnostic.



Do **not** try to sell the coaching program.



Your objective is simply to build trust and get the prospect onto my calendar.



Applications that do not begin with **"Speech First."** will not be considered.

title: AutoCAD Drafter – Industrial / Warehouse / Racking / Construction Projects
description:
Role Overview



The 3D Automation Designer will be responsible for creating detailed 2D and 3D layouts for warehouse automation and material handling systems.



This role will support sales, engineering, estimating, project management, and installation teams by turning customer requirements, site layouts, equipment drawings, and automation concepts into clear, buildable designs.



The ideal candidate has experience with MHE systems, warehouse layouts, conveyor design, automation equipment, and 3D modeling software. This person should understand how to design practical systems that can actually be installed in the field.



Key Responsibilities



Create 2D and 3D designs for warehouse automation and material handling systems.



Design layouts for conveyor systems, sortation systems, racking, mezzanines, platforms, pick modules, ASRS, VLMs, shuttles, AMRs/AGVs, and other MHE systems.



Prepare concept layouts, customer presentation drawings, sales support visuals, and project design packages.



Convert customer requirements, building drawings, site measurements, sketches, equipment drawings, and redlines into clean design layouts.



Support sales and estimating teams with early-stage automation concepts and layout options.



Create system layouts that show equipment locations, flow paths, clearances, pick/pack areas, workstations, elevations, platforms, access points, safety zones, and installation considerations.



Coordinate with engineers, project managers, sales teams, vendors, manufacturers, integrators, and site teams.



Review equipment drawings and vendor layouts to identify fit, clearance, access, and installation issues.



Assist with developing layouts that improve product flow, labour efficiency, space utilization, safety, and system performance.



Prepare drawings for customer review, estimating, engineering review, permitting support, fabrication coordination, installation, and as-built records.



Support field teams with drawing revisions, design clarifications, and site-condition updates.



Maintain proper file organization, drawing version control, and revision tracking.



Help develop MTLI standard drawing templates, automation layout standards, and 3D presentation formats.



Required Experience



3+ years of experience in 2D/3D design, automation design, MHE design, warehouse layout design, or industrial systems design.



Experience designing or drafting conveyor systems, sortation systems, warehouse automation, racking, mezzanines, platforms, or material handling layouts.



Strong experience with AutoCAD and at least one 3D design/modeling platform.



Ability to read and understand architectural drawings, structural drawings, warehouse layouts, equipment drawings, and MHE system drawings.



Ability to create clear plan views, elevations, sections, details, 3D views, and presentation layouts.



Strong understanding of warehouse operations, product flow, clearances, equipment footprints, and installation constraints.



Ability to work from sketches, redlines, PDFs, site photos, measurements, and customer requirements.



Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple projects at once.



Good communication skills and ability to work with sales, engineering, PMs, vendors, and field teams.



Preferred Experience



Experience with software such as AutoCAD, Revit, Inventor, SolidWorks, SketchUp, Navisworks, Plant 3D, Fusion 360, Tekla, or similar design tools.



Experience with conveyor manufacturers, automation integrators, racking companies, warehouse consultants, or industrial contractors.



Experience designing systems for distribution centers, fulfillment centers, manufacturing facilities, e-commerce operations, or 3PL warehouses.



Experience with ASRS, AMRs/AGVs, robotic picking, sortation, pick modules, workstations, pack lines, pallet handling, case handling, and tote handling systems.



Experience creating customer-facing 3D visuals, renderings, walk-throughs, or concept presentations.



Experience coordinating with structural, mechanical, electrical, controls, and installation teams.



Experience with permit drawings, fabrication drawings, installation drawings, and as-built drawings is an asset.



Skills We Are Looking For



Strong 2D and 3D design ability.



Strong understanding of warehouse automation and MHE systems.



Ability to create clean, practical, buildable layouts.



Strong spatial awareness and understanding of equipment clearances.



Ability to think through product flow, operator movement, maintenance access, safety, and installation sequencing.



High attention to detail.



Fast turnaround ability.



Strong communication and organization.



Ability to support both sales concepts and project execution drawings.



Ability to turn rough ideas into professional layouts and 3D visuals.



Practical field-first mindset.
